grants.description: Verify your identity using your NHS login or GOV.UK One Login
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and check your NHS records

grants.description: Allow NHS to contact your GP or midwife to confirm your pregnancy status
grants.purpose: To verify your pregnancy or recent birth for Maternity Exemption Certificate eligibility

grants.description: Provide your postal address for certificate delivery
grants.purpose: To post your Maternity Exemption Certificate (MatEx) to you

grants.description: Update your NHS medical records with MatEx certificate details
grants.purpose: To allow pharmacies and dental practices to verify your exemption when you use services

revocation.mechanism: Contact NHS Prescription Services or use your NHS account to revoke
revocation.effect: Certificate will be cancelled. You will lose free prescription and dental treatment until you reapply.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot access full medical records. Agent cannot modify pregnancy dates without explicit confirmation. Agent cannot revoke certificate on your behalf. Agent requires manual approval for sensitive edge cases (pregnancy loss, complications).
